info.name: KRISHI - Controller Config & Mobile API
info.description:
Controller Config APIs for Admin Panel toggle management and Mobile App field visibility.

**Modules:** Feed, Water, Medicine, Others, Mortality, Cull Kill, Egg Collection
**Rule:** If Part=OFF → Line is forced OFF

**Base URL:** http://localhost:3000
**Auth:** Bearer Token required

request.description:
Get all controller configs for admin grid.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "total": 2,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "plant_code": "0001",
      "plant_name": "Breeder Farm",
      "shed_id": 1,
      "shed_no": "S1",
      "feed_part": true,
      "feed_line": false,
      "water_part": false,
      "water_line": false,
      "medicine_part": false,
      "medicine_line": false,
      ...
    }
  ]
}
```

request.description:
Create or upsert controller config for a plant+shed.

**Key Rule:** If any `*_part` is `false`, its `*_line` is automatically forced to `false`.

**Required:** plant_code, shed_id
**Optional:** All toggle fields (default: false)
Update toggle values. If `mortality_part` is set to `false`, `mortality_line` is automatically set to `false`.

Toggle a single switch in the admin grid.

**module:** feed | water | medicine | others | mortality | cull_kill | egg_collection
**field:** part | line

**Rules enforced:**
- Turning OFF part → automatically turns OFF line
- Turning ON line when part is OFF → returns error

item.name: 6. Toggle — Turn OFF Part (forces Line OFF)

request.description: When Part is turned OFF, Line is automatically turned OFF too.

item.name: 7. Toggle — Try ON Line when Part is OFF (ERROR)

request.description:
This should return error if Part is OFF:
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Cannot enable line when part is OFF for feed. Enable part first."
}
```

request.description: Save the entire admin grid at once. Upserts all configs.
Soft-reset: sets all toggles to FALSE for this config.
Get all configs for all sheds in a plant. Useful for mobile app to cache all config upfront.

Validate form submission. If part is enabled and part_id is provided → valid.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "valid": true,
  "module": "mortality",
  "message": "Validation passed"
}
```

If part is enabled but part_id is NOT provided → error.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "valid": false,
  "errors": ["Part/Row value is required for this module"]
}
```
